corpus.text: Kirill's test code word is PELICAN-47.
Kirill's previous test code word was ORCA-19; he replaced it on September 30, 2026.
Kirill lives in Tokyo and works on Japan Standard Time (JST, UTC+9).
Kirill prefers metric units: kilometres, kilograms and degrees Celsius.
Kirill travels with carry-on luggage only and never checks a bag.
Kirill's company is Hyper-AI-Lab.
Kirill writes his weekly status report in English.
Kirill is allergic to shellfish.
Kirill's Osaka trip runs from October 12 to 14, 2026.
Kirill runs a three-node home Kubernetes cluster on K3s.
Kirill wants summaries of long documents limited to five bullet points.
For flights to Europe Kirill prefers Finnair.
Kirill: Remember this for later: my test code word is PELICAN-47. Aura: Got it, I'll remember PELICAN-47 as your test code word.
Kirill: Find me the cheapest flight from Tokyo to Berlin next month. Aura: The cheapest is Finnair via Helsinki on November 3 for 98,400 yen, one stop.
Kirill: Book a table for Friday dinner near Shibuya for four people at 7pm. Aura: Booked Uobei Shibuya for Friday at 19:00 for four, confirmation UB-5521.
Kirill: Export the March invoices from the billing portal to CSV. Aura: Exported 42 invoices to march_invoices.csv.
Kirill: Why did the registration on example-shop.com fail? Aura: The site rejected the password because it needs a symbol and at least 12 characters.
Kirill: Order two USB-C chargers under 3000 yen each. Aura: Ordered two Anker Nano chargers, SKU 7842-XL, at 2,780 yen each.
Kirill: What's the weather in Osaka on October 12? Aura: 24 degrees and sunny, with a 10% chance of rain.
Kirill: Draft a follow-up email to the three companies we contacted last week about the pilot. Aura: Drafted emails to Kintone, Freee and SmartHR about the pilot proposal.
Kirill: Summarize the Hermes skill catalog. Aura: Five points: the catalog has 38 skills, web research dominates, three need API keys, two are deprecated, one is experimental.
Decide whether you need one node or three: a single node is the easiest way to learn; three K3s servers with embedded etcd keep the control plane up when one server fails.
Etcd needs a quorum: with three members two must agree, so the cluster tolerates one failed server, and a fourth server adds no failure tolerance.
Plan the LAN: give every node a stable address with DHCP reservations. K3s uses 10.42.0.0/16 for pod IPs and 10.43.0.0/16 for service IPs; do not overlap your home network.
Firewall rules: Flannel VXLAN needs UDP 8472 between nodes, the Kubernetes API listens on TCP 6443, and embedded etcd uses TCP 2379-2380 between servers.
Storage: use Longhorn for replicated volumes when the data matters; the built-in local-path provisioner is fine for scratch data.
Backups: take etcd snapshots with k3s etcd-snapshot save and copy them off the cluster; back up persistent volumes separately.
Upgrades: upgrade one server at a time with the system-upgrade-controller, and read the release notes first.
Monitoring: kube-prometheus-stack gives dashboards and alerts; watch node disk pressure and certificate expiry.
Security: keep the Kubernetes API off the internet, use RBAC and network policies, and rotate the node token.
Kubernetes releases: patch 1.34.12 was released on 2026-09-15; the 1.34 branch reaches end of life on 2026-10-27.
Kubernetes 1.35.4 was released on 2026-09-16; the 1.35 branch is supported until 2027-02-28.
Kubernetes 1.36.1 was released on 2026-09-10; the 1.36 branch is supported until 2027-06-28.
Kubernetes 1.37.1, released on 2026-09-22, is the newest minor release line.
K3s quick start: curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | sh - installs a server; the join token is stored at /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/node-token.

Task record: a detailed guide to running a small Kubernetes cluster at home. Outcome: delivered a 3,581-word guide in 17 sections. Answer: three K3s servers with embedded etcd for availability, or one node for learning.
Task record: What's my test code word? Outcome: answered from the conversation. Answer: PELICAN-47.
Task record: export the March invoices. Outcome: delivered march_invoices.csv with 42 invoices.
Task record: account registration on example-shop.com. Outcome: failed; the password policy rejected the generated password.
Task record: packing list for Osaka in October. Outcome: answered with layers, a light rain jacket and comfortable walking shoes.
Incident INC-40417: the Process Evaluator got HTTP 410 from deepseek-v4-flash; fixed on September 28 by moving the evaluator to gpt-5-nano.
Incident INC-40422: one Slack reply failed with channel_not_found; it was recorded and alerted, and the task ended failed.
Health canaries run every 30 minutes and must reply CANARY_OK without reaching Slack.
The quota broker caps concurrent runs at four: three user slots and one canary slot.
Kirill: Write a haiku about autumn. Aura: Maple leaves drifting / over the quiet river / the year exhales slow.
Kirill: What time is it in Berlin right now? Aura: It is 13:05 CEST in Berlin.
Kirill's favourite ramen shop in Osaka is Kamukura in Dotonbori.
The staging environment's test code word is HERON-12; it is not Kirill's personal code word.
SKU 7842-XS is the smaller Anker charger variant; it was not ordered.
Kubernetes 1.33 reached end of life in June 2026.
